title: Session CSV export captures timings: first partial, final transcript, first SSE, total

test_cases.name: Session CSV tag and path resolution
test_cases.evidence: Session CSV tagging and target resolution verified (target=locust_sessions.csv)

test_cases.name: All required timing columns present in CSV writer schema
test_cases.expected_result: Fields list contains session_id, language, mode, first_partial, final_transcript, first_sse_event, total_sec
test_cases.evidence: All required telemetry columns verified in writer: ['session_id', 'language', 'mode', 'first_partial', 'final_transcript', 'first_sse_event', 'total_sec']

test_cases.name: Row writing outputs parseable CSV with correct values
test_cases.input_setup: Directly execute _write_session_row to a temporary CSV file
test_cases.expected_result: Valid CSV header and data row created with matching field values
test_cases.evidence: CSV file created, header written, row appended with valid contents

test_cases.name: _fire_sse_metric correctly dispatches custom metric
test_cases.input_setup: Call _fire_sse_metric with mock Environment and custom metric name
test_cases.evidence: _fire_sse_metric cleanly dispatches metric to Locust events

test_cases.name: Automated threshold evaluation triggers on SLA violation
test_cases.expected_result: process_exit_code set to 1 indicating automated test failure
test_cases.evidence: _check_thresholds sets process_exit_code=1 on fail ratio violation
